title: T1598.002 — Phishing for Information - Spearphishing Attachment
subtitle: The animation replays a complete attachment-based elicitation run against a test organization.
aria: Animated simulation of spearphishing with an attachment. An attacker sends a document with an embedded questionnaire, the employee fills in sensitive details, and the SOC runs a retro-hunt in eight steps.

nodes.label: Attacker
nodes.tip: The threat actor crafting documents that ask questions instead of running code.

nodes.label: Email Gateway
nodes.tip: The mail security gateway. It detonates attachments and logs every message.

nodes.label: Employee
nodes.tip: The person who opens the file. Training decides what happens next.

nodes.label: PDF / DOCX
nodes.tip: A clean document with a questionnaire or form inside. The story is the weapon.

nodes.label: Collection Server
nodes.tip: Where the attacker stores the answers, ready for the next stage.

nodes.label: SOC / Defender
nodes.tip: Your security team. They hunt by attachment hash and block senders.

steps.title: Craft attach
steps.caption: The attacker sends an email with a document that hides a questionnaire or a request for details.
steps.defender: The gateway logs the sender, subject, and attachment hash. Keep those records.

fields.detail: The attacker sends an email with a document that hides a questionnaire or a request for details.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Delivered
steps.caption: The gateway delivers the message because the file has no malicious code.
steps.defender: Clean files are the point. The weapon is the story, not the code.

fields.detail: The gateway delivers the message because the file has no malicious code.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Opened
steps.caption: The employee opens the document. It asks them to complete a form or review a draft.
steps.defender: Endpoint logs show the document process start. Keep process logging on.

fields.detail: The employee opens the document. It asks them to complete a form or review a draft.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Form shown
steps.caption: Inside, a 'security questionnaire' asks for staff data, VPN details, or project names.
steps.defender: A document that asks for secrets is a lure. Teach users to spot the ask.

fields.detail: Inside, a 'security questionnaire' asks for staff data, VPN details, or project names.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Data entered
steps.caption: The employee types real information into the file, believing it is official.
steps.defender: Keystrokes into a document are invisible to network tools. Awareness is the control.

fields.detail: The employee types real information into the file, believing it is official.

detection.label: No detection
detection.detail: This activity is not visible to the victim yet.

steps.title: Reply out
steps.caption: The filled file or typed answers travel back to the attacker by email reply.
steps.defender: Outbound mail with attachments to a new external domain is a strong signal.

fields.detail: The filled file or typed answers travel back to the attacker by email reply.

detection.label: Partial signal
detection.detail: A weak signal exists but is not yet a confirmed alert.

steps.title: Harvest
steps.caption: The attacker stores the answers with the rest of the target profile.
steps.defender: The data is now outside your control. Assume it will be used.

fields.detail: The attacker stores the answers with the rest of the target profile.

detection.label: Alert raised
detection.detail: The SOC has enough evidence to open an incident.

steps.title: Retro-hunt
steps.caption: The SOC hunts the attachment hash across every mailbox and blocks the sender and domain.
steps.defender: Search all mailboxes for the same hash, subject, and sender.

fields.detail: The SOC hunts the attachment hash across every mailbox and blocks the sender and domain.

detection.label: Contained
detection.detail: The activity is contained and the lesson is captured.
